name: io.github.ohneben/learnworlds-mcp
title: LearnWorlds
description: All 94 LearnWorlds LMS API endpoints as safety-categorized MCP tools (read/write/destructive).

environmentVariables.name: LEARNWORLDS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your LearnWorlds school's API, e.g. https://<your-school>.learnworlds.com/admin/api

environmentVariables.name: LEARNWORLDS_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer access token (LearnWorlds admin -> Settings -> Integrations -> Developers).

environmentVariables.name: LEARNWORLDS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your school's Client ID, sent as the Lw-Client header.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SHARED_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token required on the /mcp endpoint. Empty = open (localhost only).
